name: Ankle Fracture
definition: Fracture involving one or more malleoli and/or distal tibiofibular stabilizers, ranging from stable isolated fractures to unstable fracture-dislocations.

investigations.principle: Radiographs are guided by clinical suspicion/Ottawa rules.
investigations.MRI: CT for complex posterior malleolar or pilon-type planning; MRI is not routine.

green: Immobilization and weight-bearing plan according to stability
amber: Operative fixation depends on instability, displacement, syndesmotic injury and fracture pattern.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gulpha-bhagna principles may be integrated only after modern fracture alignment/stability management.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture involving one or more malleoli and/or distal tibiofibular stabilizers, ranging from stable isolated fractures to unstable fracture-dislocations.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, breathing/swallowing difficulty, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
